.bst-form-sample input[readonly], .bst-form-sample textarea[readonly]{cursor: default;}
.bst-form-sample__hint{margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: #475569; background: rgba(148, 163, 184, .14); border: 1px dashed rgba(100, 116, 139, .5); border-radius: 8px;}
@keyframes bs-slider-progress{from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); }}
@keyframes bs-tab-in{from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }}
@keyframes bs-fc-wave{0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: .55; } 100% { transform: scale(1.75); opacity: 0; }}
@keyframes bs-hs-pulse{from { opacity: .9; transform: scale(1); } to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.2); }}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.bs-logos--marquee .bs-logos__track{animation: none; flex-wrap: wrap; width: auto;}}

.bs-reading-progress{position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 99991; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: var(--bs-primary); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: 0 50%;}
.admin-bar .bs-reading-progress{top: 32px;}
.bs-form--labels-hidden .bs-native-form .bs-nf-label{position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0);}
@keyframes bs-slider-progress-y{from { transform: scaleY(0); } to { transform: scaleY(1); }}

.bs-atext--gradient .bs-atext__text{background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bs-atext-accent, var(--bs-primary)), var(--bs-atext-accent2, var(--bs-secondary, #f59e0b)), var(--bs-atext-accent, var(--bs-primary))); background-size: 200% 100%; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;}
.bs-atext--gradient.is-enhanced .bs-atext__text{animation: bs-atext-flow 6s linear infinite;}

.bs-mx-stagger.is-stagger-ready .bs-gallery__item{opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px) scale(.97); transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .7s var(--bs-motion-ease, cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .2, 1));}
.bs-mx-stagger.is-staggered .bs-gallery__item{opacity: 1; transform: none;}
